title.en: Samsung affiliates commit $1 billion to Helix Digital Infrastructure
title.zhHans: 三星多家关联公司向 Helix Digital Infrastructure 投资 10 亿美元

searchSummary.en: Samsung Electronics and five other Samsung affiliates announced a combined $1 billion investment in KKR-established Helix Digital Infrastructure; Samsung Electronics accounts for $500 million.
searchSummary.zhHans: 三星电子及另外五家三星关联公司宣布合计向 KKR 设立的 Helix Digital Infrastructure 投资 10 亿美元，其中三星电子出资 5 亿美元。

summary.en: Samsung Electronics and five other Samsung affiliates announced a combined $1 billion investment in KKR-established Helix Digital Infrastructure; Samsung Electronics accounts for $500 million.
summary.zhHans: 三星电子及另外五家三星关联公司宣布合计向 KKR 设立的 Helix Digital Infrastructure 投资 10 亿美元，其中三星电子出资 5 亿美元。

narrative.en: The investment connects Samsung’s semiconductor, construction, cooling, data-center, and energy-storage businesses to Helix’s data-center and power-infrastructure strategy. It remains a capital commitment; completed capacity and effects on outside operators were not observed by the cutoff.
narrative.zhHans: 该投资把三星的半导体、建设、制冷、数据中心与储能业务连接到 Helix 的数据中心和电力基础设施战略。目前它仍属于资本承诺；截至截止日，尚未观察到已完成的新增产能或对外部运营商的实际影响。

text.en: Six Samsung affiliates announced a combined $1 billion investment in Helix Digital Infrastructure.
text.zhHans: 六家三星关联公司宣布合计向 Helix Digital Infrastructure 投资 10 亿美元。

text.en: The announcement describes investment and planned cooperation, not completed infrastructure capacity or observed market restructuring.
text.zhHans: 该公告描述的是投资和计划合作，而非已经完成的基础设施产能或已观察到的市场重组。
